en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town, showing dense blocks of multi‑story stone buildings, tree‑lined streets, and a prominent church with a tall spire in the middle distance. Forested hills rise in the background. Printed text at the top in Swedish identifies the scene as a view of Sundsvall from the gasworks chimney. Some commercial signs are visible on building facades in the foreground.
